name: Reroute
doc: What objective-rrt's OBRRT_REROUTE_SCHEMA counts as the same state: level and area, keys, stars, 128-unit position; door animations, dialogs and menus as their own states; and anywhere, Mario's action class, speed (steps of 16) and rough facing (4 sectors). Coarse enough that faster duplicates are found, fine enough that a child's recorded inputs, replayed from a duplicate, land in the same place.

children.name: Motion
children.doc: Everywhere (a box over the whole level): action class, forward speed, facing.
